lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bonne Bouche.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Are you busy?
No, what's up?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I went to the surface today,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and I found a leg that belonged to a Nikke.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Crust and I got to talking,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and we started wondering who it was,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and how this had happened.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I thought it might be better knowing who she was when sending her off

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: so I tasted her.
Okay.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: However...

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I don't know exactly what happened, but

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: the only sensation that stood out

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: was that of liberation.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I've experienced all manner of different tastes in my life.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I've even tasted other Nikkes before.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: But this was the most bitter taste I've ever had the displeasure of experiencing.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: For the rest of the day, I've felt this sense of suffocation and indigestion.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: It's awful.
That's unfortunate, but what can you do?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I suppose this is what it feels like to be

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: so attuned to the emotional state of others.
Do you want to come to my room?
Where are you? I'll meet you.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: If I'm with you,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I think I'll feel better.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Do you want to come to the kitchen?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Crust said that nothing beats eating sweets when you're feeling down,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: so she's making a dessert right now.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: You and I can share it.
I'd like that.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: See you soon.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: And thank you for listening.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I know it's a heavy topic.
You can talk to me about anything, anytime.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hehe, all right.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I feel so much better already!

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hurry on over, Bonne Bouche.
I'll be there soon.
